title: FLOW AND STOCK EFFECTS OF LARGE-SCALE TREASURY PURCHASES: EVIDENCE ON THE IMPORTANCE OF LOCAL SUPPLY
summary: Owned ZN minute paths do not supply204CUSIPs, purchase quantities, substitute buckets or deliverable/CTD mapping. Do not turn operation dates alone into a long-ZN trade.
about: Fed purchases, local Treasury supply and price effects.
findings: Authors estimate about30bp cumulative yield effects and3.5bp purchased-sector operation-day effects in2009; these are cash-security yield estimates, not verified ZN profits.
mechanism: Supply removal and imperfect substitution can compensate intermediaries; the explanatory regression is not an available-at entry rule.
build_on: Owned ZN minute paths do not supply204CUSIPs, purchase quantities, substitute buckets or deliverable/CTD mapping. Do not turn operation dates alone into a long-ZN trade.

reading_scope: Abstract/introduction and methods through section3; not the full results, appendices or source bytes.
